question: Should ClickClack permanently expose separate persisted alignment controls for the current user and for all other humans and agents?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and proven, but choosing between one alignment preference, two independent preferences, or a higher-level layout model is a lasting product and UX decision that code correctness cannot settle.

options.title: Keep independent controls
options.body: Land the two-setting model so users can select every self/other alignment combination while existing users retain the current left/left default.

options.title: Keep one control
options.body: Retain the current single current-user preference and avoid expanding the appearance-settings surface.

options.title: Design layout presets
options.body: Pause this PR and replace the two raw selectors with named conversation-layout presets after a focused UX decision.

recommendation.title: Keep independent controls
recommendation.body: Land the two-setting model so users can select every self/other alignment combination while existing users retain the current left/left default.
